cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_jobs FROM jobs LIMIT 100

cases.question: Có bao nhiêu job có kỹ năng Python?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) AS python_job_count FROM jobs AS j JOIN job_skills AS js ON js.job_id = j.id JOIN skills AS s ON s.id = js.skill_id WHERE s.canonical_name ILIKE '%python%' LIMIT 100

cases.question: Có bao nhiêu job thực tập?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS internship_jobs FROM jobs WHERE employment_type ILIKE '%intern%' OR employment_type ILIKE '%thực tập%' OR employment_type ILIKE '%thuc tap%' OR title ILIKE '%intern%' OR title ILIKE '%thực tập%' OR title ILIKE '%thuc tap%' LIMIT 100

cases.question: Có bao nhiêu job ở Đà Nẵng?
cases.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM jobs WHERE location ILIKE '%đà nẵng%' OR location ILIKE '%da nang%' OR location ILIKE '%danang%' LIMIT 100

cases.question: Kỹ năng nào xuất hiện trong nhiều job nhất?
cases.sql: SELECT s.canonical_name, COUNT(DISTINCT js.job_id) AS job_count FROM job_skills AS js JOIN skills AS s ON s.id = js.skill_id GROUP BY s.canonical_name ORDER BY job_count DESC LIMIT 10
